reviews.content: Law 3: maximum eleven players; a match cannot begin or continue if either team has fewer than seven. If the number falls below seven because one or more players deliberately leave, the referee is not obliged to stop play and may apply advantage, but cannot restart after the ball goes out until the team has at least seven.
reviews.finding: The relevant Arabic clauses are visually readable. No temporary-protocol exception was found in this passage.
